opinion of the said Court it is convenient to do
so or it be so necessary in the interest of justice
and  the  expeditious  disposal  of  such  matters

make such order or deliver such judgment or
enter  such  decree  from  time  to  time  as  the
exigencies and justice of the case may require.

(3) All applications for the care and custody
of minor children shall take precedence over
